Exact bivariate polynomial coefficient comparison verifies the algebraic positivity remainder, with all three coefficients of P_r strictly positive. Endpoints u=0 or v=0 are treated. checker.py executes 1485 exact enumerated zero sums plus six independent numerical consistency quadratures, not used as proof of universality.
